CLIENT_AREA.TITLE: Client Area
CLIENT_AREA.INSTALL_APP_IOS_HINT: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen" to install.

INSTALL_PAGE.TITLE: Install the Client Portal
INSTALL_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Tap the button below to install the app on your phone or computer. Afterwards, just open it from the icon and sign in.
INSTALL_PAGE.ALREADY_INSTALLED: This app is already installed on this device.
INSTALL_PAGE.NOT_READY_YET: Install is still loading - wait a few seconds and refresh the page. On iPhone/iPad, use Share > Add to Home Screen.
INSTALL_PAGE.GO_TO_LOGIN: I already have the app, go to login

WELCOME.TITLE: Welcome to the Client Portal!
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: Let's quickly show you where to find everything here. It takes less than a minute.

HOME.TITLE: Home
HOME.DESCRIPTION: Portal news shows up here - whenever something changes around here, you'll know on this screen.

TICKETS.TITLE: Tickets
TICKETS.DESCRIPTION: Here you open a new ticket and track the progress of all your tickets.

SAC.TITLE: Feedback
SAC.DESCRIPTION: Here you register suggestions, complaints, praise or improvement requests, and track the team's reply.

CHAT.TITLE: Chat
CHAT.DESCRIPTION: Here you talk directly to the team, in real time - with text, audio or attachments.

NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Here you see alerts about your tickets and messages.

FLOATING_CHAT.TITLE: Chat shortcut
FLOATING_CHAT.DESCRIPTION: This floating button shows up on any screen and takes you straight to the Chat, no need to open the menu.

INSTALL_APP.TITLE: Install as an app
INSTALL_APP.DESCRIPTION: This button installs the Portal on your phone or computer, with its own icon, like a real app.

END.TITLE: All set!
END.DESCRIPTION: You already know your way around the Portal. You can replay this tutorial anytime by clicking "Tutorial" at the top of the screen.

PRINCIPAL.DESCRIPTION: Check back here for updates on the Portal.

BOARD.EMPTY: There are no tickets to show yet.
BOARD.DESCRIPTION: Follow your company tickets and open new ones.

NEW_TICKET.TITLE: Open a new ticket
NEW_TICKET.DESCRIPTION: Tell us what is happening. The team classifies and routes the ticket.
NEW_TICKET.SUBJECT: Subject
NEW_TICKET.SUBJECT_PLACEHOLDER: Summarise the problem in one line
NEW_TICKET.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Describe what happened, with as much detail as you can
NEW_TICKET.FILES_REQUIRED: This category requires at least one file or image.
NEW_TICKET.TRIAGE_NOTE: The team will review the ticket and route it to the right area.

AI.HINT: Type or record what's happening - AI will draft the category, subject and description below for you to review before opening the ticket.
AI.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Describe the problem in your own words...
AI.DRAFT_READY: Draft generated - review it below before confirming.
AI.ERROR: Could not generate the draft. Please fill the form manually.
AI.ERROR_NO_CATEGORIES: No categories are available for opening a ticket yet. Please fill the form manually or try again later.
AI.ERROR_EMPTY_INPUT: Write or record something before generating the draft.

MONTHLY_SURVEY.TITLE: Monthly Survey
MONTHLY_SURVEY.DESCRIPTION: Your feedback helps us improve the ERP and our support. It takes less than a minute.
MONTHLY_SURVEY.COMMENT_PLACEHOLDER: Tell us what we can improve...
MONTHLY_SURVEY.THANKS_DESCRIPTION: Your feedback was recorded. We appreciate you taking a minute for this.
MONTHLY_SURVEY.ALREADY_ANSWERED: You have already answered this month's survey.
MONTHLY_SURVEY.ERROR: Could not load the Monthly Survey. Please try again later.

ERRORS.INVALID_ANSWERS: Please answer every question before sending.

QUESTIONS.erp_overall: How do you rate the Duesoft ERP overall?
QUESTIONS.erp_meets_needs: Does the ERP meet your company's needs?
QUESTIONS.erp_ease_of_use: How do you rate how easy the ERP is to use?
QUESTIONS.erp_practicality: How do you rate the system's practicality in your daily work?
QUESTIONS.erp_performance: How do you rate the ERP's performance/speed?
QUESTIONS.support_service: How do you rate the support team's service?
QUESTIONS.support_clarity: How do you rate the clarity of the guidance you received from support?
QUESTIONS.support_response_time: How do you rate the support team's response time?
QUESTIONS.product_evolution: How do you rate the system's evolution and improvements?
QUESTIONS.overall_experience: Overall, what score would you give your experience with Duesoft?

DETAIL.NO_COMMUNICATION: No message has been sent yet.

COMMUNICATION.PLACEHOLDER: Write your message to the team

CHAT.TITLE: Chat

CSAT.FEEDBACK_PLACEHOLDER: Anything else you'd like to add? (optional)

CHAT_HISTORY.TITLE: Past conversations
CHAT_HISTORY.DESCRIPTION: Chat sessions already closed with the team.

NOTIFICATIONS.TITLE: Notifications
NOTIFICATIONS.DESCRIPTION: What the team wrote on your tickets.
NOTIFICATIONS.EMPTY: No news on your tickets yet.

PASSWORD.TITLE: Set a new password
PASSWORD.DESCRIPTION: Choose the password you will use to sign in to the Client Area.
PASSWORD.DONE_DESCRIPTION: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.

ERRORS.TOO_SHORT: The password needs at least {count} characters.
